correctness.rationale: The normal variance-mean mixture reduces the median to a gamma-normal cdf. Its zero-point imbalance has an exact Student-t form and its median slope has an exact Bessel-K form. Small-argument Bessel asymptotics give the r<1 and r=1 regimes; cancellation at the limiting median plus boundary-layer or cubic analysis gives the 1<r<3, r=3 and r>3 regimes. The known exact r=2 asymmetric-Laplace median independently matches the derived coefficient.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source proves the large-noise median limit but not its rate. The 2025 VG review records the special r=2 exact median and classical density behavior but not the five-regime expansion. Targeted searches did not locate the r=3 logarithmic median transition, the r=1 two-logarithm refinement, or the displayed constants. The 2001 generalized-Laplace monograph was not inspected in full and remains the main residual risk, so the claim is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result turns a recently established endpoint limit into a sharp all-shape phase diagram, identifies two distinct logarithmic critical regimes, supplies explicit constants, and explains the second threshold through the integrability of the cubic gamma-mixture correction.
